releases.title: BlackLanturn Build 1.1.75
releases.summary: Simpler series actions and 15-minute public browsing caches.

sections.heading: Title actions
bullets: Browse episodes directly from series and season cards. Choose a player or source on an episode or movie.
Episode player defaults are available in Settings, Playback & sync.
Remove the duplicate Details action on the current Details page, clarify episode refresh, and refresh the selected related title in place.

sections.heading: Faster browsing
bullets: Reuse saved regular Movies and Shows rows for 15 minutes before background refresh.
Trakt rows keep their 30-second freshness interval. Reload this list still requests fresh titles immediately.

sections.heading: Keep your setup
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to retain accounts, playback settings, history, sources, collections and other installed add-ons.
